name: VG Pipeline Saltville Link P-25 Line

values.PipelineName: VG Pipeline Saltville Link P-25 Line
values.OtherEnglishNames: P-25 Pipeline; VNG Saltville Link P-25 Line

researcher_notes: No existing row: no Saltville, P-25 or Virginia Gas entry in the 529-row US gas roster. The line is operating, 72 miles, runs from the Saltville gas storage facility east to near Radford, Virginia, parallel to the East Tennessee Natural Gas system. A Spectra Energy Partners press release from December 2007 (filed with the SEC) calls it a 72-mile, eight-inch line with design capacity of 40 million cubic feet per day. The EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026 (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 186, name VNG Saltville Link P-25 Line, operator Virginia Gas Co) lists it as completed June 2001, 72 miles, intrastate, state authority. EIA gives 20 inches and 30 MMcf/d; the press release says 8 inches and 40 MMcf/d. Diameter staged at 8 inches from the owner-side document; the 20 inch figure needs a person to check. Sources are two independent publishers (SEC filing and EIA), though the EIA row may repeat operator data. Passes the length rule at 72 miles sourced. Not gathering: it ends near Radford on the ETNG corridor, though a person may judge otherwise. Owner left blank: Spectra Energy Partners bought the line in April 2008 (a RTT News report confirms the agreement), and the current owner (likely Enbridge after later mergers) was not verified. Operator in EIA is Virginia Gas Co. Intrastate lines do not appear in FERC, which is not a concern here. Route not researched; RouteType unavailable until a route is found.
